name: Lucien Voss

abilities.name: Gilded Ruin
abilities.description: A burst of molten gold erupts around a foe within 8, striking everyone within 1 of it. Once per phase.

abilities.name: Objection!
abilities.description: Voss silences a foe within 6 with a word of binding law. If it doesn't resist, it loses 1 action on its next turn. Once per phase.

abilities.name: Binding Contract
abilities.description: Glowing clauses wrap a foe within 6. If it doesn't resist, it is snared (can't move) and shaken (−2 to hit) through the next DM phase. Once per phase.

abilities.name: Vanishing Act
abilities.description: Voss steps through a fold of gold light to a square within 6 and gains +2 Defense until the next player phase. Once per phase.

description: The party's court-appointed lawyer. Starts friendly and fights alongside the party. If he is ever marked hostile, he gets 4 actions per DM phase.

name: Judge Octavian Rook

abilities.name: Final Verdict
abilities.description: Brings the Gavel of Truth down on an adjacent foe for 2d8+4. On a hit, the foe is shaken (−2 to hit) through the next DM phase. Once per phase.

abilities.name: Order in the Court!
abilities.description: Rook slams his gavel and bellows for order. Each foe within 2 that doesn't resist is frightened (can't move closer to him) through the next DM phase. Once per phase.

abilities.name: Contempt of Court
abilities.description: Rook holds a pursuer within 5 in contempt. If it doesn't resist, it is snared (can't move) through the next DM phase. Once per phase.

abilities.name: Judicial Immunity
abilities.description: Rook invokes the protection of his office. Attacks against him take −5 to hit through the next DM phase. Once per phase.

abilities.name: Court Is Adjourned
abilities.description: Rook gathers his robes and hurries off. Free action: +4 movement this phase. Once per phase.

description: Starts hostile so the party can attack him at the tram. He flees instead of fighting: Judicial Immunity, Court Is Adjourned, then Order in the Court or Contempt of Court on whoever chases him.

name: Gideon

abilities.name: Trip Attack
abilities.description: A sweeping longsword strike at an adjacent foe. On a hit, the foe is knocked prone and can't move through the next DM phase. Once per phase.

abilities.name: Second Wind
abilities.description: Gideon steadies himself and recovers 1d10+4 HP. Free action, once per phase.

description: A knight and a former member of the party's treasure-hunting crew. Token is a placeholder until his lineage is decided.
